map.CKD-EPI 2009：141×min(Scr/κ,1)^α×max(Scr/: CKD-EPI 2009: 141 x min(Scr/κ,1)^α x max(Scr/κ,1)^(-1.209) x 0.993^age x (female x 1.018) x race coefficient; κ = 0.9 for men and 0.7 for women, α = -0.411 for men and -0.329 for women; race coefficient 1 for non-Black and 1.159 for Black patients (the CKD-EPI 2021 equation uses 1, i.e., no race adjustment)

map.eGFR 和肌酐哪个准？: Which is more accurate, eGFR or creatinine?
map.血肌酐受肌肉量、饮食影响；eGFR 用公式校正年龄性别更接近真实肾功能，是 CK: Serum creatinine is affected by muscle mass and diet; eGFR corrects for age and sex, comes closer to true kidney function and is the main basis for CKD staging and dosing, but it still needs to be combined with cystatin C, urine protein and more.
map.单位搞错会怎样？: What happens if the unit is wrong?
map.该工具血肌酐可选 µmol/L 或 mg/dL（µmol/L 时 ÷88.4 转: This tool accepts serum creatinine in either µmol/L or mg/dL (µmol/L is divided by 88.4); the egfr-calculator version also supports both units. Entering the wrong unit is off by about 88 times, so check the unit dropdown first.
map.算法（CKD-EPI 2009，种族系数可选）：男 κ=0.9、女 κ=0.7（: Algorithm (CKD-EPI 2009, optional race coefficient): κ = 0.9 for men, 0.7 for women (serum creatinine in mg/dL; this tool accepts either µmol/L or mg/dL and converts from the dropdown); eGFR = 141×min(SCr/κ,1)^α×max(SCr/κ,1)^(-1.209)×0.993^age×(female ×1.018)×(Black ×1.159). α: men -0.411, women -0.329. Stages: ≥90 G1, 60-89 G2, 45-59 G3a, 30-44 G3b, 15-29 G4, <15 G5. Note: CKD-EPI 2021 removed the race coefficient.
map.例1（血肌酐 80µmol/L、50 岁、男）：SCr=80/88.4=0.90: Example 1 (serum creatinine 80 µmol/L, age 50, male): SCr = 80/88.4 = 0.905 mg/dL, eGFR = 141×(0.905/0.9)^(-1.209)×0.993^50 ≈ 98.6 mL/min/1.73m², G1 (normal). Example 2 (serum creatinine 200 µmol/L, age 65, female): SCr = 2.262 mg/dL, eGFR = 141×(2.262/0.7)^(-1.209)×0.993^65×1.018 ≈ 22.0, G4 (severe decline).
